title: Card Manifest
description: Schema for catalog-side index entries that register a card emission. Lives at data-catalog/manifests/cards/{card_id}/{emission_id}/manifest.yaml. The catalog consumer uses this to answer 'what card emissions exist for (target, indication, release_pin, data_mode)?' without walking S3 or re-reading evidence packages. See plan § Scaffolding § data-catalog § manifests/cards/ (B1) and § compose-dashboard subsection (1) Manifest resolution algorithm.

manifest_kind.description: Discriminator for the data-catalog's mixed-manifest directory; always 'card_emission' for entries that validate against this schema.

card_id.description: Stable card identifier matching a card_spec in target-contracts/cards/.

card_version.description: Exact semver of the card_spec at emission time. NOT a range — manifests pin to specific versions.

emission_id.description: Stable identifier for this specific emission run. Convention: {card_id}-{target}-{indication}-{release_pin}-{data_mode}-{seq}.

subgroup_spec.description: The subgroup binding active at emission time. Either a list of subgroup_ids, the literal 'all', or null.

data_mode.description: Resolution mode active at emission time. See data_mode.enum.yaml.

validation_state.description: Card-emission outcome. Only pass / passed_with_warnings are emitted; failed emissions do not produce a card_manifest (see A2 rule).

warning_ids.description: Structured warning identifiers that fired (when validation_state is passed_with_warnings).

s3_uri.description: S3 URI to the card-emission directory (containing summary.json, figure.svg, plot_data.parquet, manifest.yaml).

dashboard_spec_ref.description: Reference to the dashboard_spec that composed this card emission (e.g., 'target-contracts/dashboards/target-in-indication.dashboard_spec.yaml@<git_sha>').

evidence_package_id.description: Optional. The evidence_package this card emission belongs to (if part of a composition). Cards emitted standalone (e.g., during method development) may omit.

canonical_decision_refs.description: References to canonical-decisions records that gated the input manifests. Required for governance-grade packages (resolves open item #8).

interpretation_call.description: The interpretation label this emission produced (e.g., 'strong upregulation', 'not informative').
